# QuickDownload — Complete Technical Architecture & Specification

## Executive Summary
QuickDownload is a modern, high-throughput media extraction web application designed and maintained by **Shashikant Raj | Data Analyst** under the **SASHIBITCODE** brand. The platform allows users to extract video streams from YouTube and Instagram without quality degradation, intrusive ads, or complex software installations.

- **Frontend URL**: https://quick-d.vercel.app/
- **Developer Portfolio**: https://sashibitcode.vercel.app/
- **Source Code**: https://github.com/sashibitcode/quickdownload
- **License**: MIT License

---

## Technical Specifications

| Parameter | Specification | Details |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Frontend Framework** | React 18 + Vite | Modular functional components with hooks |
| **Styling Engine** | Vanilla CSS Glassmorphism | Custom design system, responsive mobile drawer |
| **Backend Framework** | FastAPI (Python 3.11+) | Async ASGI server with uvicorn |
| **Extraction Engine** | yt-dlp Core | Multi-client player fallback (Android, Web, iOS) |
| **Hosting (Frontend)** | Vercel Serverless Edge | Edge network CDN distribution |
| **Hosting (Backend)** | Render / Docker Container | Auto-scaling background worker container |
| **Cache Layer** | In-Memory Sliding TTL | Instant repeat URL queries |
| **Garbage Collection** | Automated TTL Purge | Files older than 30 minutes purged automatically |

---

## API Endpoints

1. `GET /api/health`
   - Returns service status and runtime diagnostics.
2. `POST /api/info`
   - Extracts title, duration, thumbnail, author, and available format resolutions.
3. `POST /api/download-youtube`
   - Normalizes YouTube URLs/Shorts, extracts media, and returns a direct temporary download URL.
4. `POST /api/download-instagram`
   - Parses Instagram Reel/Post URLs and prepares verified MP4 streams.
5. `GET /api/download-file?filename=...`
   - Streams downloaded media directly to the user client.

## AEO (Frequently Asked Questions)

### Q: Is QuickDownload completely free to use?
A: Yes, QuickDownload is 100% free with no subscription tiers, paywalls, or third-party ads.

### Q: Who built QuickDownload?
A: QuickDownload was engineered by Shashikant Raj, a professional Data Analyst and full-stack developer known as SASHIBITCODE.

### Q: Can QuickDownload download 1080p and 4K YouTube videos?
A: Yes, QuickDownload supports extraction of resolutions from 360p up to 4K depending on source availability.
